config.encoder: torchvision resnet18, ImageNet weights (IMAGENET1K_V1), CPU, no fine-tuning
config.input: RGB (red, green, blue reflectance clipped to [0, 0.3] and scaled to [0, 1], ImageNet normalisation) of the 960 m window (96 px) upsampled x2 to 192 px, before and after separately
config.features: after embedding minus before embedding (512) and the absolute difference (512)
config.model: logistic regression C=0.05, class_weight balanced, StandardScaler, same unit-held-out GroupKFold as the other baselines
config.declared: single configuration fixed before the first run; not tuned
config.dependency: optional: requirements-satellite-optional.txt (torch CPU wheels); the stage is skipped with a recorded reason when torch is missing
